long_name: IOIPG Malaysia Real Estate Investment Trust

profile.summary: IOIPG Malaysia Real Estate Investment Trust established with the principal investment policy of investing, both directly and indirectly, in a diversified portfolio of income producing Real Estate Assets located in Malaysia used for retail, commercial, office, industrial and hospitality purposes and such other Non-Real Estate Assets in Malaysia. IOIPG Malaysia Real Estate Investment Trust operates as a subsidiary of IOI Properties Group Berhad. IOIPG Malaysia Real Estate Investment Trust was incorporated in Malaysia.
profile.zh: IOIPG Malaysia Real Estate Investment Trust 是一家在马来西亚注册成立的房地产投资信托，为 IOI Properties Group Berhad 的子公司。其主要投资策略是直接或间接投资于马来西亚境内多元化的创收房地产资产组合。
lines: 零售物业：投资马来西亚用于零售用途的创收房地产资产。
商业与办公物业：投资马来西亚用于商业和办公用途的创收房地产资产。
工业物业：投资马来西亚用于工业用途的创收房地产资产。
酒店物业：投资马来西亚用于酒店用途的创收房地产资产。
非房地产资产：投资马来西亚的其他非房地产资产。
lines_en: Retail properties: invests in income-producing real estate assets used for retail purposes in Malaysia.
Commercial and office properties: invests in income-producing real estate assets used for commercial and office purposes in Malaysia.
Industrial properties: invests in income-producing real estate assets used for industrial purposes in Malaysia.
Hospitality properties: invests in income-producing real estate assets used for hospitality purposes in Malaysia.
Non-real estate assets: invests in other non-real estate assets in Malaysia.
